readout_other: Compound muscle action potentials from plantar foot muscles; Masson's trichrome nerve histology; toe-spread and gait observation
direction_notes: CMAP amplitude fell with increasing intensity: transient decline recovering by 28 days at the three lower exposures, and no measurable CMAP at 7 or 28 days at 7,890 W/cm2.
safety_notes: At the highest exposure nerves appeared necrosed with thickening and adhesions; histology showed axon swelling and myelin disruption, and haemorrhagic regions were seen at the two highest exposures.

exposures.label: 5.7 MHz HIFU, 5 s, four intensities, rat sciatic nerve

timing.protocol_description: Single 5-s HIFU application per nerve with the focus placed at the centre of the exposed sciatic nerve via a titanium cone applicator; four intensities (390, 2,255, 3,310 and 7,890 W/cm2 spatial peak, temporal peak). Short-term (13 rats, recordings to 4 h) and long-term (27 rats, 7 or 28 days) studies used the same exposures.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Using a visually guided approach, 26 rat sciatic nerves (13 Sprague–Dawley rats, 350 – 450 g) were treated with four different HIFU exposures: 5-s applications with acoustic intensities of 390, 2,255, 3,310, and 7,890 W/cm<sup>2</sup>.
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The HIFU device was a 5.7-MHz single-element transducer with a solid titanium cone attachment, developed for visually guided HIFU applications.<sup>11</sup> The titanium cone, attached to the face of a spherically curved piezoelectric crystal (PZT), acted as a coupling medium between the transducer and the nerve.
